description: Minimuthu Pathirannehelage Stephen v. Mercantile Credit Limited Minimuthu Pathirannehelage Stephen v. Mercantile Credit Limited View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Minimuthu Pathirannehelage Stephen v. Mercantile Credit Limited Minimuthu Pathirannehelage Stephen v. Mercantile Credit Limited View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court judgement imposing liability on him as guarantor under a hire purchase agreement, arguing that only one decree could be entered in the action; Section 188 of the Civil Procedure Code. Held - the hirer and guarantors were jointly and severally liable, and judgment against some defendants did not prevent judgment against another as per Section 89 of the Civil Procedure Code. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
